The petitioners have filed the present writ petitions seeking for a writ of mandamus directing the first respondent to consider the petitioners' claim petitions filed under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 dated 07.09.2023, 11.11.2023, 20.10.2023, 21.11.2023, 21.11.2023, 20.06.2023,
28.02.2022, 28.9.2023, 09.12.2021 and 20.04.2023 respectively and enhance the compensation in respect of the subject properties by following the procedure contemplated under Sections 26 to 30 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.35882, 35885, 35887, 35888, 35890, 35892, 35893 and 35895 of 2023 Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 (Central Act 30 of 2013 ) and also following the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the lands belonging to the respective petitioners had been acquired for expansion of road project by the National Highways Authority of India and separate Awards have already been passed and the compensation has been determined by the original authority.

The petitioners herein are not satisfied with the valuation of the subject lands fixed by the authorities, and thus, they preferred the aforementioned claim petitions / appeals before the first respondent/Arbitrator under Section 3-G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

3. Since these writ petitions are filed for Mandamus simplicitor, to direct the first respondent to dispose of the claim petitions / appeals of the petitioners, this Court, without expressing any view or opinion with regard to the merits of the case, directs the first respondent to consider and dispose https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.35882, 35885, 35887, 35888, 35890, 35892, 35893 and 35895 of 2023 of the appeals filed by the petitioners, after giving due opportunity of hearing to the petitioners as well as rival claimants/interested parties if any and pass appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. With the above directions, these Writ Petitions are disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
